description: Target regions of the Simulation Window (/simulation) and the atlas labels each one is built from. Read by build_sim_anatomy.py, which writes the meshes (public/sim/anatomy.bin.gz) and the label map (public/sim/regions.nii.gz). Region centroids, hemisphere centroids and volumes are not stored anywhere: the page computes them from the label map when it loads.

schaefer2018.labels: Parcel names from CBIG's Schaefer2018_400Parcels_17Networks_order.txt, matched by network and anatomical tag (e.g. VisPeri_StriCal matches 17Networks_LH_VisPeri_StriCal_1)
schaefer2018.licence: MIT (Computational Brain Imaging Group) — see public/sim/NOTICE.md

regions.name: Primary visual cortex (V1)
regions.rationale: The parcels Schaefer labels striate (calcarine) cortex, which is V1 by definition.
regions.replaces: Harvard-Oxford intracalcarine + supracalcarine cortex + occipital pole

regions.name: Dorsolateral PFC
regions.rationale: Lateral and dorsal prefrontal parcels of the frontoparietal control networks; the closest overlap with the middle frontal gyrus of the parcel groups tried.

regions.name: Ventromedial PFC
regions.rationale: Medial orbitofrontal (limbic B) and medial prefrontal (default A) parcels. Schaefer has no vmPFC parcel; together these cover medial OFC, subgenual and pregenual cortex, and also reach into dorsomedial PFC.

regions.name: Insula
regions.rationale: Every parcel Schaefer labels insular, across the three networks that reach the insula.

regions.name: Auditory cortex
regions.rationale: The parcels Schaefer labels auditory. They cover Heschl's gyrus and the surrounding superior temporal cortex, so the region is larger than primary auditory cortex.

regions.name: Sensorimotor cortex (M1/S1)
regions.rationale: Schaefer's somatomotor parcels around the central sulcus. Network parcels do not separate precentral (M1) from postcentral (S1) cortex, so the region is named for both.
